title: Edge blank sender blocking is enabled
description: The Edge Transport server MUST have blank sender blocking enabled in the sender filter configuration. Mail with a blank MAIL FROM address is typically used in bounce spam and backscatter attacks. Accepting blank-sender mail generates non-delivery reports directed at innocent third parties.
subject: Server

references.name: Microsoft — Sender filtering on Edge Transport servers
DISA STIG EX19-ED-000085: The Exchange Sender Filter must block messages that have a blank From address (V-259609)
DISA STIG EX19-ED-000087: The Exchange Sender Filter must be enabled (V-259610)

remediation.description: Enable blank sender blocking with Set-SenderFilterConfig -BlankSenderBlockingEnabled $true.

considerations: Some automated systems legitimately use a blank MAIL FROM for bounce notifications. Verify that enabling this setting does not block required notification mail before enforcing it in production.
